name: Chord Conversation
description: Alternate whole held chords rather than their individual notes.

name: Every Other Key
description: Alternate played notes, keeping pitch and touch unchanged.

name: Human Touch
description: Small velocity changes on every key.

name: Linked Surprises
description: Occasional higher, softer, shorter notes; all three changes happen together.

name: Octave Sparks
description: One note in four jumps up an octave.

name: Short or Long
description: Notes choose between a sixteenth and a quarter.

name: Sparse Reply
description: About two thirds of the notes pass, with a little variation of touch.

name: Three Note Answer
description: Three notes through, then one rest.
